subject: merge-sort

composition.story: Merge sort divides the collection into single items, then repeatedly merges sorted pairs until the entire array is fully ordered.

aha.observation: Combining two sorted halves creates a single larger sorted sequence.

states.why: Splitting reduces the problem into smaller independent pieces.

states.label: Subdivide
